auto.title: Arriving by Car
items: Distance from Palermo Airport (Falcone-Borsellino): about 30 minutes (30 km).
Route: Take the A29 motorway towards Palermo. Follow signs for the historic center.
Parking: available in the area, both free and paid. Contact us at check-in for more details!

treno.title: Arriving by Train
items: Distance from Central Station: 10 minutes walk.
Follow signs for the historic center. Enjoy a short walk through the beauty of Palermo!

info.title: Useful Information
paragraphs: 🎫 Bus ticket cost: about €1.40. 📍 Where to buy tickets? On board the bus or at authorized sales points.
🚶 You can also reach us on foot from the Central Station (10-15 minutes), enjoying the historic streets.
❓ Need help? Contact us or visit the official AMAT Palermo website for updated schedules.

object.title: 1. Subject Matter
object.description: These general terms govern the booking and stay at Thalea Apartment, located at Via Cagliari 5, Palermo.

booking.title: 2. Bookings
items: The booking is considered confirmed upon receipt of the email confirmation.
At the time of booking, partial or full payment may be required as a guarantee.
The guest must provide accurate and up-to-date details at the time of booking.

payment.title: 3. Payments
payment.description1: Payments can be made by credit card, debit card or other supported electronic methods (Stripe, PayPal).
payment.description2: The full balance must be paid within the deadline indicated in the booking confirmation.

cancellation.title: 4. Cancellations
cancellation.description: Cancellation within 24 hours before check-in is free and can be requested by emailing thaleapalermoapartment@gmail.com. After this deadline, 50% of the stay will be charged; in case of no-show, 100%.

checkin.title: 5. Check-in and Check-out
items: Check-in: from 14:00.
Check-out: by 10:00.
Any changes must be agreed in advance.

guest.title: 6. Guest Obligations
items: Respect the apartment, furnishings and common areas, avoiding damage.
Do not exceed the maximum number of guests indicated in the booking.
Respect the house rules communicated at check-in.

liability.title: 7. Liability of Thălēa Apartment
liability.description: Thălēa Apartment is not responsible for theft, loss or damage to guests' personal belongings. It is the guests' responsibility to keep their personal effects safe.

forceMajeure.title: 8. Force Majeure
forceMajeure.description: In the event of unforeseen events (e.g. natural disasters, health emergencies) that prevent the stay, Thălēa Apartment may cancel the booking without obligation of compensation, except for the refund of any amounts already paid.

law.title: 9. Applicable Law
law.description: These terms are governed by Italian law. The Court of Palermo shall have jurisdiction for any dispute.

collectedData.title: 2. Types of data collected
collectedData.description: We collect and process the following personal data:
items: Personal and contact data: first name, last name, email, phone number.
Booking data: arrival and departure dates, number of guests, specific preferences.
Payment data: information needed to complete the transaction (securely managed via external providers such as Stripe or PayPal).
Navigation data: cookies, IP address, browser type, pages visited, for statistical and service improvement purposes.

processingPurpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
items: Management of bookings and communications with guests.
Fulfillment of legal and accounting obligations.
Sending communications related to the stay, updates or special offers (only with express consent).
Anonymous statistical analysis to improve services offered.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis of processing
items: Performance of a contract (vacation rental booking).
Fulfillment of legal obligations.
User consent for promotional communications or newsletter.

dataRetention.title: 5. Data retention
items: Booking data: up to 10 years for tax purposes.
Anonymized navigation data: up to 24 months.
Marketing data: until consent is revoked.

thirdParty.title: 6. Disclosure to third parties
thirdParty.description: Personal data may be disclosed to:
items: Payment service providers (Stripe, PayPal).
IT and hosting service providers.
Public authorities, if required by law.
thirdParty.note: Data will not be sold to third parties for commercial purposes without the express consent of the user.

rights.title: 7. Rights of the data subject
rights.description: The guest has the right to:
items: Access their personal data.
Request rectification or deletion of data.
Request restriction of processing or data portability.
Object to processing for legitimate reasons.
Withdraw consent at any time.
rights.note: To exercise these rights, contact the data controller at the details given in section 1.

security.title: 8. Data security
security.description: Thălēa Apartment adopts technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, loss or alteration. Payment data is managed exclusively through certified and secure external providers.

policyUpdates.title: 9. Policy updates
policyUpdates.description: Thălēa Apartment reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy. Updates will be published on the website and indicated with the revision date.

contacts.title: 10. Contacts
contacts.description: For any information or request regarding privacy:
items: Email: thaleapalermoapartment@gmail.com
